Hilda Kirsten is a UFS instructor of the military.

She is a born Esper.

Personality
To her recruits, Hilda shows a cold-hearted facade and punishes everybody not living up to her expectations, but she has a feminine side underneath. Hilda is brave and a normally collected woman.

She is feared by her subordinates, who call her the "cold-hearted Hilda" because of her extremely rigorous training and thorough instruction. However, she is not only unnecessarily strict, and also praises them when they achieve good results, understands their individual characteristics and thoughts, and gives them guidance tailored to their individual needs, so although she is feared, she is not hated, but rather trusted and feared. Although no one can say so, all the male subordinates secretly wish that they could have a mission with her rather than with the other men they are undercover with.

Appearance
She has long dark brown hair and yellow eyes.

History
Background
Hilda was born into a military family of the UFS and was trained in hand-to-hand and with firearms combat since childhood. She was born with an Esper ability.

She later became a veteran intelligence officer and instructor in the UFS's Intelligence Organization. Se specializes in infiltration missions into enemy territory, and can enter any location using his exceptional ability to control people and his glamorous body. She is willing to open up her body if necessary, and she always manages to captivate her opponents. When it comes to perceiving the power of hypnosis, she is a force to be reckoned with, and it is said that there is no information she cannot get her hands on. Despite her reputation as a soldier who puts her duty and contribution to the organization first, she is not complacent about this and never misses her daily training and drills.
